script.title: CHAMPAGNE GEL, PLEASE
script.scene_zh: 美甲沙龍 · 凝膠美甲
script.story_hook: Grace drives forty minutes for one shade.
script.intro_zh: 格蕾絲開了四十分鐘的車，只為一抹香檳色。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today we're at the nail salon.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天我們來到美甲沙龍。
script.outro: Perfect polish, patient hands. See you after three weeks!
script.outro_zh: 漂亮的指甲，耐心的雙手。三週後再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the nail salon phrases together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起跟讀美甲沙龍會用到的句子。
script.char_a_description: a graduate woman in her mid-twenties, long black hair held by a silk headband, a cream knit sweater, gray tights, red canvas sneakers, petite build, holding a small tote purse, smiling shyly.
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her thirties, bright purple hair in two neat braids, a denim apron over a striped long-sleeve tee, black slim jeans, white sneakers, small build, warm dimpled smile.

script.youtube_title_en: "It Already Looks Brand New" - Asking for a Champagne Gel Manicure
script.youtube_description:
想約一款香檳色凝膠美甲，英文卻開不了口？
美甲沙龍裡，格蕾絲遇到色號缺貨的小風波：找近似色、確認卸除不傷甲、洗碗要戴手套，60 句連貫美語全都有。
你會聽到：
🎧 指定顏色："Do you have a gel color called Champagne?"
🎧 確認流程："How long do hands take?"
🎧 保養提問："How do I make these last three weeks?"
🎧 開心收尾："It already looks brand new."
後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再跟著說。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
每天一段生活對話，讓耳朵和嘴巴一起進步。
喜歡請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，下一集見！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

Follow Grace through a full nail salon visit: a sold-out color, a close match, removal questions, and after-care tips. These 60 lines of natural American English turn small mishaps into big learning moments. The second half is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat workout for your ears and your voice. Ideal for A2 learners who love beauty shop English. No memorizing, just listen often. Subscribe for a new dialogue every week. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
坐在美甲沙龍裡，怎麼用英文說「我要香檳色，但不要太高調」？
色號賣完了怎麼辦？卸除傷不傷甲？每一個問題你都得聽懂。
這一集帶大家走進美式美甲店，看格蕾絲為了一抹香檳色凝膠，經歷缺貨、換近似色、中途接電話，最後開心刷卡，約好下次卸除。
你會聽到：
🎧 指定顏色："Do you have a gel color called Champagne?" 報出色號最簡單的說法。
🎧 缺貨應變："Let me check the back room." 店員幫你補救的第一步。
🎧 保養叮嚀："Wear gloves for dishes and cleaning." 讓美甲撐更久的秘訣。
🎧 收尾安排："Book the removal now, then bye!" 下一次卸除這樣約。
後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60 個句子先聽一遍、再跟著說一遍，從耳朵練到嘴巴。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。把這些句型聽熟，換你開口也不怕。
祝你下次躺進美甲椅，也能從容地說出每一句英文。
script.thumbnail_action: holding both hands up to show off the gel shine

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you have a gel color called Champagne?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju hæv ə dʒɛl ˈkʌlɚ kɔld kæmˈpeɪn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！你們這裡有一款叫香檳色的凝膠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must be Grace. Saved you a chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju məst bi ɡɹeɪs seɪvd ju ə tʃɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您一定是格蕾絲吧！幫您留好位子囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me! I'm here for gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts mi aɪm hiɹ fɔɹ dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是我！我是來做凝膠美甲的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. Any chipping trouble?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪs ˈɛni ˈtʃɪpɪŋ ˈtɹʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。指甲有容易剝落的困擾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad. My last polish chips in two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd maɪ læst ˈpɑlɪʃ tʃɪps ɪn tu deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 很嚴重，上次指甲油兩天就剝落了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gel fixes that. It cures under the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl fɪksɛz ðæt ɪt kjuɚz ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 凝膠可以解決，它要在燈下照乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want something classy, not too bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈklæsɪ nɑt tu bɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我想要低調有質感的顏色，不要太鮮豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Champagne is soft gold-pink. Fancy.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæmˈpeɪn ɪz sɔːft ɡoʊd pɪŋk ˈfænsi/
dialogue.zh: 香檳色是柔和的金粉色，很高級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly it! Will it match my skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt wɪl ɪt mætʃ maɪ skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是它！會適合我的膚色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On fair skin, it glows like pearls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn fɛɹ skɪn ɪt ɡloʊz laɪk pɜɹlz/
dialogue.zh: 您的膚色偏白，塗上會像珍珠發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beautiful. Um, is one coat enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbjutəfəl ʌm ɪz wʌn koʊt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 太美了。嗯，上一層夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two coats, plus a shiny top layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu koʊts plʌs ə ˈʃaɪni tɑp ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 要上兩層，再加一層亮面封層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds dreamy. Show me the bottle?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ˈdɹimi ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來超夢幻。可以讓我看看那瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oops, the shelf here is completely bare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps ðə ʃɛlf hɪɹ ɪz kəmˈplitli bɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哎呀，這一層架子整個空空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, what? But I drove forty minutes!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌt bʌt aɪ dɹoʊv ˈfɔɹti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 等等什麼？我開了四十分鐘的車才到！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry! The truck restocks it Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsɑɹi ðə tɹʌk ˈɹiːstɑks ɪt ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！補貨車星期二會把顏色補齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday? I need them done today!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪ aɪ nid ðɛm dʌn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週二？我今天就要漂亮出席！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it. Let me check the back room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt ɪt lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə bæk ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。我去後面倉庫找一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. I'll wait right here, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪl weɪt raɪt hɪɹ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩您了，我在這兒等，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Blush Sparkle, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt blʌʃ ˈspaɹkəl siː/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！這款叫「粉霞微光」，您看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, that's lovely. Very close.
dialogue.phonetic: /u ðæts ˈlʌvli ˈvɛɹi kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 喔，很美耶！跟香檳色非常接近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one has tiny gold shimmer inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn hæz ˈtaɪni ɡoʊd ˈʃɪmɚ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這一瓶里面含金色細閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take it. How long do hands take?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ɪt haʊ lɔŋ du hænz teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 就它了。做雙手要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About eighty minutes, start to finish.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈeɪti ˈmɪnəts stɑɹt tə ˈfɪnɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 從修整到照燈，大約八十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Will removal hurt my nails?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wɪl ɹɪˈmuzəl hɜɹt maɪ neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 好。卸除的時候會不會傷指甲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope. I soak them off, no filing.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp aɪ soʊk ðɛm ɑf noʊ ˈfaɪlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，我用浸泡卸掉，不打磨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nails get oily. Can you prep twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪlz ɡɛt ˈɔɪli kæn ju pɹɛp twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我的指甲偏油，可以先清潔兩次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a double wipe helps it grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ə ˈdʌbl waɪp hɛlps ɪt ɡɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 當然，重擦兩次會更抓得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think of everything. Start anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɪŋk əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ stɑɹt ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 您想得太週到了。隨時都可以開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, gentle filing. Careful now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst ˈdʒɛntəl ˈfaɪlɪŋ ˈkɛɹfəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 先輕輕修型。手請放平，小心喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That file feels soft, not rough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt faɪl filz sɔːt nɑt ɹʌf/
dialogue.zh: 這個銼條摸起來軟軟的，不粗糙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap files tear nails, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip faɪlz tɛɹ neɪlz tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 便宜的銼條會撕傷指甲，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ouch! Sorry, you caught the skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ ˈsɑɹi ju kɔt ðə skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哎喲！抱歉，您剪到皮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep breath, I'll be so gentle now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip bɹɛθ aɪl bi soʊ ˈdʒɛntəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸，我這下會更輕更輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine, really. Much better, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn ˈɹɪli mʌtʃ ˈbɛtɚ siː/
dialogue.zh: 真的沒關係。現在好多了，您看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you. Coat one, into the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju koʊt wʌn ˈɪntə ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 感謝。第一層進烤燈囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This lamp is warm and cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs læmp ɪz wɔɹm ænd ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 這盞燈暖暖的，好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety seconds. Watch the white ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti ˈsɛkəndz wɑtʃ ðə waɪt ɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 九十秒。燈圈變白就是好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone has a call coming in.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn hæz ə kɔl ˈkʌmɪŋ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我手機來電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Answer it, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænsɚ ɪt aɪl weɪt raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您先接，我在這兒等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, it's my boss. Work trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi ɪts maɪ bɔs wɜɹk ˈtɹʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，是我老闆，工作有點狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fine. Gel will wait, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli faɪn dʒɛl wɪl weɪt ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，凝膠隨時都等您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to you. Sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ju ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 回來啦，剛剛真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stress. Coat two, then top coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stɹɛs koʊt tu ðɛn tɑp koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 不緊張。上第二層，然後封層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add one tiny pearl, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd wʌn ˈtaɪni pɜɹl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再加一顆小小的珍珠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the ring finger, it's my style.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ɹɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡɚ ɪts maɪ staɪl/
dialogue.zh: 無名指上一顆，就是我的風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! You're reading my mind again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jʊɹ ˈɹidɪŋ maɪ maɪnd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 對！您又猜中我的心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Both hands, look at them glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn boʊt hænz lʊk æt ðɛm ɡloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 完成！兩隻手，看看這光澤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look... it already looks brand new.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪt ɔlˈɛdi lʊks bɹænd nu/
dialogue.zh: 你看……它們看起來已經像新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One day off, and you'll love it more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ ɑf ænd jul lʌv ɪt mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 再過一天，您會更愛它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I make these last three weeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ meɪk ðiz læst θɹi wikz/
dialogue.zh: 要怎樣才能讓它撐滿三週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear gloves for dishes and cleaning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹ ɡlʌvz fɔɹ ˈdɪʃɪz ænd ˈklinɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 洗碗和打掃的時候，請戴手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gloves, check. What about the edges?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlʌvz tʃɛk wʌt əˈbaʊt ði ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 手套，記下了。邊緣起皮怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oil them nightly, they'll stay sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɪl ðɛm ˈnaɪtli ðeɪl steɪ sild/
dialogue.zh: 每晚抹油，就會緊緊封住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last question: how much with the pearl?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst ˈkwɛstʃən haʊ mʌtʃ wɪð ðə pɜɹl/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個問題：加珍珠多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-eight, pearl on the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti eɪt pɜɹl ɑn ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 四十八元，珍珠那顆免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free art? Your prices are so fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ɑɹt jɔɹ ˈpɹaɪsɚz ɑɹ soʊ fɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 免費彩繪？您的定價太公道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash, card, or app, all good here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ kɑɹd ɔɹ æp ɔl ɡʊd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 現金、刷卡或是 App 都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card! And see you in three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹd ænd si ju ɪn θɹi wikz/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡！三週後再來找您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Book the removal now, then bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊk ðə ɹɪˈmuzəl naʊ ðɛn baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先把卸除約好，再見囉！
